gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the rear camera bundled with a portable CarPlay screen only works with that screen model. Carpuride sells its replacement rear camera at $30 and tells buyers to pick the variant that matches their screen's version number. ESSGOO's 10.26-inch screens split the same way: the H26 is built for an AHD rear camera, while the TS0001's in-box list has no camera at all. So 'supports a backup camera' and 'has a camera input' do not mean any camera will work.
standout_why: I compared against cartechtalk.com (IIWEY iK7, HAUXIY Q9S, Krunia), gearnudge.com (Carpuride W903/W125S/C3/C92/C98/W103 Pro) and carcody.com (backup cameras plus Amazon 7–10.26-inch screens). gearnudge and carcody already explain the reverse-trigger wire, and carcody already warns that an HD camera won't show HD on a standard-definition input, so the wiring and signal points are partly covered. None of them says that cameras for portable screens are specific to one model, or that two 10.26-inch ESSGOO models at similar prices differ in whether a camera is in the box. None of them states input power the same way across brands either: Carpuride's 10.3-inch W103 lists 'Type-C 5V 2.5A' while its 9-inch W901 Pro lists 'DC 12V-24V'.
decides: This backs up ChatGPT's 'check that the rear camera is in the box' advice and makes it more precise. The shopper should buy the bundle that includes the camera, because adding a camera later means buying the maker's camera for that exact model. Carpuride's costs $30. A generic camera can't be assumed to work, especially on an AHD unit like the ESSGOO H26. It also rules out the ESSGOO TS0001 ($99.99), whose in-box list names no camera, for this question. The pick is the H26 ($119.99) or another listing that names the rear camera in the kit. Whichever screen it is, the reverse view switches on by itself only if the camera's red wire is spliced into the reverse-light +12V.

findings.label: How the screen knows you're in reverse
findings.value: The backup light's +12V goes to the unit's 'Reverse'/'Backup' wire. When you shift into reverse the light comes on and the unit switches to camera mode. Some units also need the reversing program turned on in settings.
